tasks.title: Setup Project Repository and Development Environment
tasks.description: Initialize the SoccerX project repository with proper structure for iOS, watchOS, and Firebase backend components. Configure development environment with required dependencies and tools.
tasks.details: Create Xcode workspace with iOS and watchOS targets. Set up Swift Package Manager for dependencies. Initialize Firebase project and configure services (Authentication, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Functions). Create folder structure as specified: iOS/ (Core/, Features/, Shared/), watchOS/ (Tracking/, UI/, Services/), Backend/ (Functions/, Security/, Scripts/). Configure .gitignore for Swift/Xcode/Firebase. Set up CI/CD pipeline basics. Install Firebase CLI tools. Configure development certificates and provisioning profiles for both iOS and watchOS apps.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify Xcode builds successfully for both iOS and watchOS targets. Ensure Firebase project is accessible and all services are enabled. Test that development certificates are properly configured by building to physical devices. Validate folder structure matches architectural requirements.

subtasks.title: Create Xcode Workspace Structure
subtasks.description: Initialize Xcode workspace with iOS and watchOS targets, configure project settings, and establish the foundational app structure
subtasks.details: Create new Xcode workspace named 'SoccerX.xcworkspace'. Add iOS app target 'SoccerX' with deployment target iOS 16.0+. Add watchOS app target 'SoccerXWatch' with deployment target watchOS 9.0+. Configure bundle identifiers (com.soccerx.app, com.soccerx.app.watchkitapp). Enable required capabilities: HealthKit, Location Services, Background Modes, Push Notifications for iOS; HealthKit, Location Services, Background Modes for watchOS. Create folder groups matching specified structure: iOS/Core/, iOS/Features/, iOS/Shared/, watchOS/Tracking/, watchOS/UI/, watchOS/Services/. Configure shared schemes for development and production builds.
subtasks.testStrategy: Build both targets to verify no compilation errors. Run on iOS Simulator and watchOS Simulator to ensure basic app launch. Verify all capabilities are properly configured in project settings.

subtasks.title: Initialize Firebase Project and Services
subtasks.description: Set up Firebase project with all required services and download configuration files for iOS integration
subtasks.details: Create Firebase project named 'soccerx-app' via Firebase Console or CLI. Enable Authentication service with Sign in with Apple provider. Initialize Firestore database in production mode with initial security rules. Enable Cloud Storage with default bucket. Set up Cloud Functions project structure in Backend/functions/. Download GoogleService-Info.plist and add to both iOS and watchOS targets. Create Backend folder structure: Backend/Functions/src/, Backend/Security/rules/, Backend/Scripts/. Initialize Functions project with TypeScript template using 'firebase init functions'. Configure Firebase emulator suite for local development.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify Firebase project appears in console with all services enabled. Test Firebase CLI connection with 'firebase projects:list'. Ensure GoogleService-Info.plist is properly added to both app targets. Run 'firebase emulators:start' to verify local development setup.

subtasks.title: Configure Swift Package Manager Dependencies
subtasks.description: Add and configure all required Swift packages for Firebase SDK, networking, and UI components
subtasks.details: Add Firebase iOS SDK via Swift Package Manager (https://github.com/firebase/firebase-ios-sdk). Select required Firebase products: FirebaseAuth, FirebaseFirestore, FirebaseStorage, FirebaseMessaging, FirebaseFunctions. Configure Firebase initialization in AppDelegate/App struct with FirebaseApp.configure(). Add additional packages: Alamofire for networking fallback, SwiftLint for code quality, KeychainAccess for secure storage. Create Package.swift manifest if using local packages for shared code. Configure build settings to link Firebase frameworks properly with both targets. Set up module imports in respective target files.
subtasks.testStrategy: Clean build to verify all packages resolve correctly. Import Firebase modules in a test file to verify proper integration. Run SwiftLint to ensure it's properly configured. Test basic Firebase initialization doesn't crash on app launch.

subtasks.title: Setup Development Environment and CI/CD Pipeline
subtasks.description: Configure development certificates, provisioning profiles, and establish basic CI/CD pipeline structure
subtasks.details: Generate App IDs for both iOS and watchOS apps in Apple Developer Portal. Create development and distribution certificates. Generate provisioning profiles for development, ad-hoc, and App Store distribution. Configure automatic code signing in Xcode project settings. Create .gitignore file with proper exclusions for Swift/Xcode/Firebase artifacts. Set up Fastlane with initial Fastfile for build automation. Create GitHub Actions workflow file (.github/workflows/ios-build.yml) with basic build and test steps. Configure secrets in repository for certificate passwords and API keys. Install Firebase CLI globally and document in setup instructions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Build to physical iPhone and Apple Watch to verify certificates work. Run 'fastlane init' and execute basic lane. Trigger GitHub Actions workflow on test branch to verify CI builds. Ensure sensitive files are properly ignored by git.

subtasks.title: Create Initial Project Documentation and Configuration
subtasks.description: Set up essential project documentation, configuration files, and development guidelines
subtasks.details: Create README.md with project overview, setup instructions, and development workflow. Add CLAUDE.md file with AI assistant guidelines for the codebase structure. Create development configuration files: .swiftlint.yml for code style, firebase.json for emulator settings, .firebaserc for project aliases. Set up environment configuration files for Development and Production in Config/ directory. Create Makefile or shell scripts in Scripts/ for common tasks (setup, build, deploy). Document Firebase project configuration including security rules boilerplate. Add CHANGELOG.md for version tracking. Create pull request and issue templates for GitHub.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run setup script to verify it correctly configures development environment. Test SwiftLint rules work as expected. Verify Firebase emulator configuration loads properly. Ensure all documentation is accessible and accurate by following setup steps on a clean machine.

tasks.title: Implement Authentication with Sign in with Apple
tasks.description: Create authentication flow using Sign in with Apple integrated with Firebase Authentication. Implement secure user session management and token handling.
tasks.details: Configure Sign in with Apple capability in Xcode project settings. Implement AuthenticationManager service using Firebase Auth SDK. Create SignInView with Apple button following HIG guidelines. Handle authentication state changes with Combine publishers. Implement secure token storage in iOS Keychain. Create user document in Firestore upon first sign-in with initial user data structure. Handle authentication errors gracefully. Implement session persistence (30-day duration as specified). Add biometric lock option for app access. Create proper sign-out functionality that cleans up local data.
tasks.testStrategy: Test Sign in with Apple flow on physical devices (simulator limitations). Verify user creation in Firebase Console. Test token persistence across app launches. Validate session expiration after 30 days. Test biometric lock functionality. Ensure proper cleanup on sign-out. Test error scenarios (network failure, cancelled sign-in).

subtasks.title: Configure Sign in with Apple Capability and Firebase Integration
subtasks.description: Set up Sign in with Apple entitlement in Xcode project settings and configure Firebase Authentication provider for Apple sign-in support
subtasks.details: Add Sign in with Apple capability in project settings under Signing & Capabilities. Enable Apple provider in Firebase Console Authentication settings. Add AuthenticationServices framework to project. Configure associated domains for webcredentials. Update Info.plist with required Apple sign-in keys. Create service identifier in Apple Developer portal if needed. Add Firebase Auth SDK to project dependencies via Swift Package Manager.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify capability appears in entitlements file. Confirm Firebase Console shows Apple provider enabled. Test framework import compiles successfully.

subtasks.title: Build AuthenticationManager Service with Firebase Auth SDK
subtasks.description: Create a singleton service class that handles all authentication operations using Firebase Auth and manages authentication state with Combine publishers
subtasks.details: Create AuthenticationManager class as ObservableObject singleton. Implement @Published properties for authState, currentUser, and isAuthenticated. Set up Firebase Auth state listener in init(). Create signInWithApple() method using ASAuthorizationController. Implement credential exchange with Firebase Auth. Add error handling enum for authentication failures. Create Combine publishers for auth state changes. Implement automatic token refresh logic.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test auth state publisher emissions. Mock Firebase Auth responses. Test error handling for various failure scenarios. Verify singleton behavior.

subtasks.title: Create SignInView UI and Keychain Integration
subtasks.description: Build the sign-in interface following Apple HIG with secure token storage in iOS Keychain for session persistence
subtasks.details: Design SignInView with SignInWithAppleButton following HIG specifications. Implement ASAuthorizationControllerDelegate methods. Create KeychainManager for secure token storage using Security framework. Store Firebase auth tokens and refresh tokens securely. Implement 30-day session persistence by storing session expiry date. Add loading states and error alerts. Create smooth transition animations to main app view upon successful authentication.
subtasks.testStrategy: UI test Sign in with Apple button appearance and tap behavior. Test Keychain read/write operations. Verify session persistence across app launches. Test 30-day expiration logic.

subtasks.title: Implement Biometric Lock and User Document Creation
subtasks.description: Add biometric authentication for app access and create initial user document structure in Firestore upon first sign-in
subtasks.details: Implement BiometricAuthManager using LocalAuthentication framework. Add Face ID/Touch ID permission in Info.plist. Create toggle in settings for biometric lock preference. Store preference in UserDefaults. Implement biometric check on app launch if enabled. Create Firestore user document with initial structure: uid, email, displayName, createdAt, lastLoginAt, preferences object, statistics object. Handle document creation only on first sign-in. Update lastLoginAt on subsequent logins.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test biometric prompt on various devices. Verify Firestore document creation with correct structure. Test preference persistence. Validate biometric fallback to passcode.

subtasks.title: Handle Sign-Out and Error Scenarios
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive sign-out functionality with local data cleanup and graceful error handling for all authentication scenarios
subtasks.details: Create signOut() method in AuthenticationManager that calls Firebase Auth signOut. Clear all Keychain stored tokens and credentials. Reset all @Published properties to initial state. Clear any cached user data from memory. Implement UserDefaults cleanup for user preferences. Create comprehensive error handling for network failures, invalid credentials, user cancellation, and Apple ID issues. Display user-friendly error messages with retry options. Add analytics tracking for auth events.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test complete data cleanup after sign-out. Verify no user data persists in Keychain or UserDefaults. Test each error scenario with appropriate UI feedback. Validate analytics events fire correctly.

tasks.title: Build watchOS Real-time Game Tracking Engine
tasks.description: Develop core workout tracking functionality for Apple Watch including GPS, heart rate monitoring, and motion tracking with battery optimization.
tasks.details: Create WorkoutManager class implementing HKWorkoutSession for soccer activity type. Configure HealthKit permissions and capabilities. Implement LocationManager with adaptive GPS accuracy based on movement speed (kCLLocationAccuracyBest for active play, kCLLocationAccuracyNearestTenMeters for low activity). Set up CoreMotion for additional movement detection. Create GameDataPoint struct for 5-second interval data aggregation. Implement battery optimization logic that adjusts sensor update frequencies. Create local data persistence for offline scenarios. Implement workout pause/resume functionality. Add pre-game countdown timer. Create SwiftUI views for active tracking display showing main stats, heart rate detail, speed detail, splits, and calories.
tasks.testStrategy: Test GPS accuracy in various conditions (indoor, outdoor, different speeds). Verify heart rate data collection from actual Apple Watch. Measure battery consumption during 2-hour sessions (target < 10%). Test offline data collection and storage. Validate sensor frequency adjustments based on activity level. Test pause/resume functionality during games.

subtasks.title: Configure HealthKit and Core Motion Permissions
subtasks.description: Set up HealthKit capabilities and permissions for the watchOS app, configure Core Motion access, and create the necessary Info.plist entries for health data access
subtasks.details: Add HealthKit capability to watchOS target in Xcode. Create HealthKitManager class to handle authorization requests for activeEnergyBurned, heartRate, distanceWalkingRunning, and workout data. Configure Info.plist with NSHealthShareUsageDescription and NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription. Set up Core Motion entitlements for CMMotionActivityManager and CMPedometer access. Create permission request flow that triggers on first app launch. Implement fallback handling if permissions are denied.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test permission flows on real Apple Watch device. Verify all requested health data types are properly authorized. Test app behavior when permissions are denied. Validate that permission strings appear correctly in system dialogs.

subtasks.title: Implement WorkoutManager with HKWorkoutSession
subtasks.description: Create the core WorkoutManager class that manages HKWorkoutSession for soccer activity type, handles workout lifecycle, and coordinates data collection from various sensors
subtasks.details: Create WorkoutManager class as ObservableObject for SwiftUI integration. Configure HKWorkoutSession with activityType: .soccer and locationType: .outdoor. Implement workout state management (preparing, running, paused, stopped). Set up HKWorkoutBuilder for accumulating workout data. Create delegate methods for session state changes. Implement pause/resume functionality with proper session handling. Add pre-game countdown timer (configurable 5-60 seconds). Create error handling for session failures. Implement background mode configuration for continuous tracking.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test workout session lifecycle on physical Apple Watch. Verify background execution continues when app is not in foreground. Test pause/resume maintains data continuity. Validate countdown timer accuracy. Monitor memory usage during long sessions.

subtasks.title: Build Adaptive GPS and Motion Tracking System
subtasks.description: Implement LocationManager with dynamic GPS accuracy based on movement patterns and create motion detection system using Core Motion for enhanced activity recognition
subtasks.details: Create LocationManager class implementing CLLocationManagerDelegate. Implement adaptive GPS accuracy switching: use kCLLocationAccuracyBest when speed > 2 m/s (active play), kCLLocationAccuracyNearestTenMeters when speed < 0.5 m/s (standing), kCLLocationAccuracyHundredMeters during paused state. Set up CMMotionActivityManager to detect running, walking, stationary states. Create movement pattern analyzer combining GPS speed and motion data. Implement location filtering to remove GPS jitter. Set distance filter dynamically (5m for active, 20m for low activity). Create speed calculation with smoothing algorithm. Add altitude tracking for field elevation changes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Field test GPS accuracy switching during actual soccer play. Measure battery impact of different accuracy modes. Test motion detection accuracy for soccer-specific movements. Verify location updates continue in background.

subtasks.title: Create Data Aggregation and Battery Optimization Engine
subtasks.description: Develop the GameDataPoint structure for 5-second interval data collection and implement intelligent battery optimization by adjusting sensor update frequencies based on activity level
subtasks.details: Create GameDataPoint struct with timestamp, location (lat/lng), speed, distance, heartRate, calories, and activityLevel properties. Implement 5-second aggregation timer that collects and averages sensor data. Create BatteryOptimizationManager that monitors device battery level and activity patterns. Implement sensor frequency adjustments: High activity (HR: 1Hz, GPS: 1Hz, Motion: 5Hz), Medium activity (HR: 0.5Hz, GPS: 0.5Hz, Motion: 2Hz), Low activity (HR: 0.2Hz, GPS: 0.1Hz, Motion: 1Hz). Add data buffering for efficient batch processing. Create rolling window calculations for real-time stats. Implement data compression for storage efficiency.
subtasks.testStrategy: Measure actual battery consumption over 2-hour sessions (target < 10% drain). Test sensor frequency switching responsiveness. Verify data aggregation accuracy. Monitor CPU usage during peak activity. Test data integrity after compression.

subtasks.title: Develop SwiftUI Tracking Interface and Local Persistence
subtasks.description: Create the watchOS SwiftUI views for live tracking display and implement local data persistence for offline game recording with automatic sync queuing
subtasks.details: Build main tracking view showing elapsed time, distance, current/avg/max speed, heart rate, and calories. Create detailed views accessible via digital crown: HeartRateDetailView with zones and efficiency, SpeedDetailView with pace chart, SplitsView showing 10-minute intervals, CaloriesDetailView with burn rate. Implement Core Data stack for local storage with GameSession and DataPoint entities. Create offline persistence manager that stores up to 7 days or 50MB of game data. Build sync queue system marking data for upload when iPhone connection restored. Add visual indicators for GPS signal strength and heart rate connection. Implement haptic feedback for milestone achievements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test UI responsiveness during active tracking. Verify offline data persists across app restarts. Test sync queue behavior when storage limits reached. Validate UI updates match sensor data frequency. Test haptic feedback timing and intensity.

tasks.title: Implement Watch-iPhone Data Synchronization
tasks.description: Create robust bidirectional data sync between Apple Watch and iPhone using WatchConnectivity framework with offline support and data queuing.
tasks.details: Implement WatchConnectivityManager singleton for both iOS and watchOS targets. Create real-time data transfer during active games using sendMessage for immediate delivery when reachable. Implement background transfer using transferUserInfo for reliability. Create data queuing system supporting up to 7 days of offline data or 50MB limit. Implement priority-based sync (Critical: game summary, High: GPS/heart rate, Medium: detailed metrics, Low: raw sensor data). Add data compression using zlib for GPS routes. Implement sync rules based on connection type (WiFi: all data, Cellular: critical+high only). Create sync status UI indicators. Handle connection state changes gracefully. Implement retry logic for failed transfers.
tasks.testStrategy: Test real-time sync during active game with iPhone nearby. Test offline game recording and subsequent sync. Verify data integrity after compression/decompression. Test queue limits (7 days/50MB). Validate priority-based sync on different connection types. Test sync reliability with connection interruptions.

subtasks.title: Create WatchConnectivityManager Core Infrastructure
subtasks.description: Implement singleton WatchConnectivityManager classes for both iOS and watchOS targets with session activation, connection state management, and bidirectional communication protocols
subtasks.details: Create WatchConnectivityManager.swift in iOS/Shared/Services/ implementing WCSessionDelegate. Initialize WCSession singleton with proper activation sequence. Implement session activation handlers (activationDidCompleteWith, sessionDidBecomeInactive, sessionDidDeactivate). Create connection state enum (notActivated, activated, notReachable, reachable). Implement reachability monitoring with Combine publishers. Add session state observers for UI updates. Create shared message types enum for standardized communication. Implement error handling for session activation failures.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test session activation sequence. Mock WCSession for testing delegate callbacks. Verify state transitions with different connection scenarios. Test error handling for activation failures.

subtasks.title: Implement Real-Time and Background Data Transfer
subtasks.description: Build message sending infrastructure for immediate delivery during active games and background transfer system for reliable data synchronization
subtasks.details: Implement sendMessage() wrapper with automatic fallback to transferUserInfo when not reachable. Create message priority enum (critical, high, medium, low). Build sendGameUpdate() for real-time score/event updates using sendMessage. Implement sendBulkData() for GPS/sensor data using transferUserInfo. Create message batching system to optimize transfer efficiency. Add completion handlers with retry logic (3 attempts with exponential backoff). Implement didReceiveMessage and didReceiveUserInfo handlers on both platforms. Create message routing system based on message type. Add telemetry for transfer success/failure rates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test sendMessage with reachable/unreachable states. Verify automatic fallback to transferUserInfo. Test message batching with various data sizes. Validate retry logic with simulated failures.

subtasks.title: Build Offline Data Queue with Priority Management
subtasks.description: Create persistent queue system for offline data storage with 7-day retention, 50MB limit, and priority-based management
subtasks.details: Implement DataQueueManager using Core Data for persistence. Create QueuedMessage entity with fields: id, priority, payload, timestamp, retryCount, compressed. Build enqueue() method with automatic size checking and oldest-first eviction when approaching 50MB limit. Implement 7-day retention policy with daily cleanup job. Create priority-based dequeue algorithm (Critical->High->Medium->Low). Add queue status monitoring (itemCount, totalSize, oldestItem). Implement queue persistence across app launches. Create queue compaction routine to optimize storage. Add telemetry for queue health metrics.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test queue persistence across app termination. Verify 50MB limit enforcement with large datasets. Test 7-day cleanup with time manipulation. Validate priority-based dequeuing order.

subtasks.title: Implement Data Compression and Connection-Aware Sync
subtasks.description: Add zlib compression for GPS routes and implement intelligent sync rules based on network connection type
subtasks.details: Integrate zlib compression for GPS coordinate arrays with 60-70% expected compression ratio. Create CompressionManager with compress() and decompress() methods. Implement connection type detection (WiFi/Cellular/None) using NWPathMonitor. Build SyncRulesEngine with connection-based filtering: WiFi (all data), Cellular (critical+high only). Create bandwidth estimation for adaptive sync rates. Implement progressive sync for large datasets. Add sync throttling to prevent battery drain. Create sync status enum (idle, syncing, paused, completed). Build UI indicators showing sync progress and connection status.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test compression ratios with real GPS data. Verify decompression accuracy with checksums. Test connection type detection accuracy. Validate sync rule enforcement on different networks.

subtasks.title: Create Sync Status UI and Error Recovery System
subtasks.description: Build user-facing sync status indicators and implement robust error recovery mechanisms for failed transfers
subtasks.details: Create SyncStatusView component showing real-time sync progress, queue size, and last sync timestamp. Implement circular progress indicator for active syncs. Build connection status badge (green=WiFi, yellow=Cellular, red=Offline). Create sync history log showing last 10 sync operations. Implement user-triggered manual sync with pull-to-refresh. Build error recovery system with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s max). Create conflict resolution for simultaneous edits. Implement data integrity validation with checksums. Add sync analytics events for monitoring. Create debug view for troubleshooting sync issues.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test UI updates with various sync states. Verify error recovery with network interruptions. Test conflict resolution with simultaneous edits. Validate progress indicators accuracy.

tasks.title: Design and Implement Firestore Database Schema
tasks.description: Create comprehensive Firestore database structure with collections, security rules, and composite indexes for optimal performance.
tasks.details: Create Firestore collections: users/{userId}, games/{gameId}, groups/{groupId}, leaderboards/{groupId}_{weekId}, achievements/{userId}. Implement data models in Swift matching schema structure. Create Firestore security rules ensuring users can only access their own data, group data readable by members only, proper permission checks for updates. Set up composite indexes: games [userId, startTime DESC], games [userId, mvpScore DESC], groups [memberIds, isPublic], leaderboards [groupId, weekId]. Implement repository pattern for data access. Create Firebase Cloud Storage structure for GPS route data with proper access controls. Implement data validation rules. Set up automatic timestamps and data consistency checks.
tasks.testStrategy: Test CRUD operations for each collection. Verify security rules prevent unauthorized access. Test composite index performance with sample data. Validate data consistency across related collections. Test Cloud Storage upload/download for GPS routes. Verify proper error handling for permission denied scenarios.

subtasks.title: Design Core Firestore Collections and Data Models
subtasks.description: Create the foundational Firestore collections structure and corresponding Swift data models for users, games, groups, leaderboards, and achievements
subtasks.details: Define Firestore collections: users/{userId} with fields (displayName, email, profileImageUrl, stats, achievements, groupIds, createdAt, updatedAt), games/{gameId} with fields (userId, startTime, endTime, duration, distance, avgSpeed, mvpScore, gpsRoute, heartRateData, events), groups/{groupId} with fields (name, description, creatorId, memberIds, inviteCode, isPublic, weeklyChallenge), leaderboards/{groupId}_{weekId} with fields (rankings array with userId, score, gamesPlayed), achievements/{userId} with fields (achievementId, unlockedAt, progress). Create corresponding Swift structs with Codable protocol for seamless Firestore integration. Implement computed properties for derived values and helper methods for data transformation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for Swift model encoding/decoding, validate all required fields are properly mapped, test computed properties with edge cases

subtasks.title: Implement Firestore Security Rules and Access Control
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive security rules ensuring proper authentication, authorization, and data access controls for all collections
subtasks.details: Write Firestore security rules: users collection - allow read/write only if request.auth.uid == userId, games collection - allow read if request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId or user is in same group, allow write only if request.auth.uid == userId, groups collection - allow read if resource.data.isPublic == true or request.auth.uid in resource.data.memberIds, allow update if request.auth.uid == resource.data.creatorId or updating only own membership, leaderboards - allow read if user is group member, write denied (server-only), achievements - allow read if request.auth.uid == userId, write denied (server-only). Implement field-level validation rules for data types, required fields, and value constraints. Add timestamp validation to prevent backdating.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use Firebase emulator to test unauthorized access attempts, verify proper permission grants for authorized users, test edge cases like removed group members

subtasks.title: Create Composite Indexes for Query Performance
subtasks.description: Define and deploy Firestore composite indexes for optimized query performance on common access patterns
subtasks.details: Create firestore.indexes.json with composite indexes: games collection - [userId ASC, startTime DESC] for user game history, [userId ASC, mvpScore DESC] for personal best queries, [groupId ASC, startTime DESC] for group game feeds, groups collection - [memberIds ARRAY_CONTAINS, isPublic ASC] for user's groups query, [createdAt DESC] for public group discovery, leaderboards collection - [groupId ASC, weekId DESC] for current/historical leaderboards. Add single-field indexes for frequently filtered fields: games.distance, games.duration, users.displayName. Deploy indexes using Firebase CLI and monitor index usage in Firebase console. Document query patterns that require these indexes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Execute complex queries using Firebase emulator, measure query performance with sample datasets of 10K+ documents, verify no missing index errors

subtasks.title: Build Repository Pattern for Data Access
subtasks.description: Implement repository classes in Swift providing clean abstraction layer for Firestore operations with offline support and caching
subtasks.details: Create BaseRepository protocol with generic CRUD operations and error handling. Implement UserRepository, GameRepository, GroupRepository, LeaderboardRepository, and AchievementRepository classes. Add offline persistence configuration with Firestore's enablePersistence(). Implement data caching strategy with memory cache for frequently accessed data. Create custom error types for network failures, permission denied, and data validation errors. Add retry logic with exponential backoff for transient failures. Implement batch operations for efficient multi-document updates. Create Observable wrappers using Combine for real-time data streams. Add transaction support for atomic operations across multiple documents.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test CRUD operations with mock Firestore, verify offline data persistence, test error handling for various failure scenarios, validate transaction atomicity

subtasks.title: Set Up Cloud Storage for GPS Routes and Media
subtasks.description: Configure Firebase Cloud Storage structure for GPS route data and implement secure upload/download functionality with proper access controls
subtasks.details: Create Cloud Storage folder structure: /users/{userId}/profile/ for profile images, /games/{gameId}/gps_routes/ for compressed GPS data, /games/{gameId}/media/ for game photos/videos, /groups/{groupId}/media/ for group content. Implement storage security rules matching Firestore permissions. Create GPSRouteCompressor utility using zlib to reduce GPS data size by 70-80%. Implement StorageManager class with methods for uploadGPSRoute(), downloadGPSRoute(), uploadMedia(), getDownloadURL(). Add progress callbacks for large file transfers. Implement automatic cleanup for orphaned files. Set up Cloud Functions trigger to generate thumbnails for uploaded images. Add metadata tags for efficient querying.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test GPS data compression ratios, verify storage security rules block unauthorized access, test upload/download with various file sizes, validate cleanup of orphaned files

tasks.title: Develop MVP Score Calculation System
tasks.description: Implement the MVP score algorithm as Firebase Cloud Functions with weighted metrics for distance, speed, heart rate efficiency, and consistency.
tasks.details: Create Firebase Function processGameCompletion triggered on game document creation. Implement MVP score calculation with weights: distance (0.3), avgSpeed (0.2), maxSpeed (0.15), heartRateEfficiency (0.2), consistency (0.15). Create normalization functions for each metric (0-100 scale). Implement heart rate efficiency calculation based on age and fitness level. Calculate consistency from split times variation. Update game document with calculated MVP score. Trigger user stats update and leaderboard recalculation. Implement Douglas-Peucker algorithm for GPS route simplification before storage. Add weather data integration for contextual scoring. Create error handling and logging for debugging.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit test MVP calculation with various game data inputs. Verify score ranges (0-100). Test normalization functions with edge cases. Validate Cloud Function triggers properly on game creation. Test performance with high-load scenarios. Verify GPS route compression effectiveness.

subtasks.title: Create Firebase Function Trigger and Basic Structure
subtasks.description: Set up the Firebase Cloud Function that triggers on game document creation and establish the basic function structure with error handling and logging
subtasks.details: Create processGameCompletion function in Backend/functions/src/triggers/. Configure onCreate trigger for games/{gameId} collection. Set up TypeScript interfaces for game data, player metrics, and MVP score result. Implement basic error handling with try-catch blocks and structured logging using Firebase Functions logger. Add function timeout configuration (540 seconds) to handle complex calculations. Create helper function structure for metric calculations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests to verify function triggers correctly on document creation. Test error handling with malformed game data. Verify logging outputs correct structured data. Test timeout handling for long-running calculations.

subtasks.title: Implement Metric Normalization Functions
subtasks.description: Create normalization functions to convert raw game metrics into standardized 0-100 scale values for MVP score calculation
subtasks.details: Create normalizeDistance function using logarithmic scale (0-15km range). Implement normalizeSpeed for average speed (0-25 km/h) and max speed (0-35 km/h) with linear scaling. Build normalizeHeartRate function considering age-based max heart rate (220-age) and fitness zones. Create normalizeConsistency using coefficient of variation from split times. Implement edge case handling for outliers and invalid values. Add configurable thresholds for each metric type stored in Firebase Remote Config.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test each normalization function with edge cases (0, negative, extremely high values). Verify all outputs are within 0-100 range. Test with real-world metric ranges from sample game data. Validate age-based heart rate calculations for different age groups.

subtasks.title: Build MVP Score Calculation Engine
subtasks.description: Implement the weighted MVP score algorithm that combines normalized metrics into a final score
subtasks.details: Create calculateMVPScore function with configurable weights: distance (0.3), avgSpeed (0.2), maxSpeed (0.15), heartRateEfficiency (0.2), consistency (0.15). Implement heart rate efficiency calculation using percentage of time in optimal zone (60-80% max HR). Calculate consistency score from standard deviation of 5-minute split distances. Add bonus multipliers for exceptional performance (>90th percentile in any metric). Implement score capping at 100 and floor at 0. Create detailed score breakdown object showing contribution of each metric.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test MVP calculation with various game scenarios (short games, long games, high intensity, steady pace). Verify weight distribution adds up to 1.0. Test edge cases where some metrics are missing. Validate score distribution across large dataset follows expected bell curve.

subtasks.title: Integrate GPS Route Processing and Weather Context
subtasks.description: Implement Douglas-Peucker algorithm for GPS route compression and integrate weather data for contextual scoring adjustments
subtasks.details: Implement Douglas-Peucker algorithm to compress GPS routes while maintaining accuracy (epsilon = 5 meters). Create function to reduce GPS points by 70-90% before Cloud Storage upload. Integrate OpenWeatherMap API to fetch weather data at game location/time. Apply weather modifiers to MVP score: temperature penalty outside 15-25°C range, wind speed impact on running metrics, precipitation bonus for playing in rain. Store compressed route in Cloud Storage with reference in game document. Add weather data to game metadata for historical context.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test GPS compression maintains route shape accuracy within 5-meter tolerance. Verify compression ratio achieves 70%+ reduction. Test weather API integration with rate limiting and error handling. Validate weather modifiers produce reasonable score adjustments (+/- 10%).

subtasks.title: Implement Database Updates and Cascade Triggers
subtasks.description: Update game documents with MVP scores and trigger cascading updates to user statistics and group leaderboards
subtasks.details: Update game document with mvpScore, scoreBreakdown, processedAt timestamp, and compressedRouteUrl. Trigger updateUserStats function to recalculate user's average MVP score, total games, and achievement progress. Implement updateGroupLeaderboards function to recalculate weekly rankings for all user's groups. Add transaction support to ensure atomic updates across collections.
